summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing completed for Pride Bingo app. All core functionalities working correctly including single player mode, multiplayer room creation/joining, bingo card mechanics with B-I-N-G-O headers, FREE space, auto-daub, manual/auto number calling, and responsive design across desktop/tablet/mobile viewports.
passed_tests: Backend API connectivity and all endpoints (100% success rate)
Single player game creation with 1-4 cards
Bingo card generation with correct B-I-N-G-O structure and FREE space
Room listing and player count display
Homepage with pride theme and mode selection cards
Navigation between all pages (home, single player, multiplayer, game room)
Responsive design across desktop (1920x1080), tablet (768x1024), and mobile (390x844) viewports
Neo-brutalist design elements (hard shadows, thick borders)
Called numbers board with real-time updates
